data.title: Your data
data.intro: The shop keeps only what it needs to serve you. Below is a summary; the full text is the shop's data policy.
data.item.name: Zalo name
data.item.nameWhy: To call you by your name.
data.item.nameKeep: Kept until you delete the account.
data.item.phone: Phone number, if you allow it
data.item.phoneKeep: Kept until you withdraw it or delete the account.
data.item.ordersWhy: To make your order, issue invoices and reconcile.
data.item.ordersKeep: Invoices are kept as the law requires; your name is removed from orders when you delete the account.
data.item.stampsWhy: To add stamps and give gifts.
data.item.stampsKeep: Kept until you delete the account.
data.notStored: The shop keeps no location, contacts, Zalo messages or bank card numbers of yours.
data.copySub: Ask the staff at the counter; the shop sends the copy within the legal time.
data.complainSub: Talk to the staff at the counter or message the shop's page on Zalo.
data.marketingSub: Turn them on or off under Me.
data.deleteSub: Deletes your data. It cannot be undone.
data.deleteIntro: When you delete your account, the shop deletes the data below. It cannot be undone.
data.delete.name: Your Zalo name and the linked Zalo id
data.willKeep: The shop keeps, as the law requires
data.keep.invoices: Invoices and payment records already issued: kept for the legal period, no longer linked to your Zalo account.
data.keep.orders: Past orders: without your name, sales figures only.
data.keep.backups: Backups are cleared on the shop's schedule.
data.warning: Stamps and gifts will be lost. With an order still open the account cannot be deleted; wait for it to finish and try again.
data.confirmBody: The shop receives the request and deletes your data within the legal time. You can make a new account at any time; its stamp card starts from 0.
data.confirmCheck: I understand that {stamps} stamps and unused gifts will be lost for good.
data.blocked: You have {count} orders still open. Wait for them to finish, then delete the account.
data.visitorOnly: This account has not joined the member programme, so the app cannot take the deletion request yet. Ask the staff at the counter; the shop deletes it within the legal time.
data.sent: The shop received your request to delete the account.
data.failed: The request was not sent. Check your connection and try again.
